description: Tests whether zero-shot embedding matching plus fuzzy template slots can replace padatious with no training step at all: Model2Vec's prototype-mode pipeline takes the first shot with class prototypes embedded straight from registered templates, and Nebulento's fuzzy template matching backs it up for slot extraction and runtime-registered templates.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: m2v-prototype (see sibling fighter) shows that prototype-mode embedding similarity alone, with no trained head, can match runtime-registered intents. But it still lacks slot extraction. Nebulento fills that gap with template-based slot extraction and its own runtime-registered templates, so pairing it with the prototype pipeline's zero-shot front door tests a fully training-step-free replacement for padatious, not merely a front door for it. Comparators: padatious-stock (the trained baseline this fighter is trying to unseat), m2v-first/m2v-nebulento (the classifier-mode embedding fighters this pipeline is a zero-shot sibling to), and m2v-prototype (isolates whether adding Nebulento's fuzzy backstop helps over the pure prototype fighter alone). conf_high/conf_medium/conf_low on the prototype block are the cosine-calibrated defaults from ovos-m2v-pipeline PR #91. REQUIRES ovos-m2v-pipeline>=0.9.0a1 — the calibrated thresholds land with ovos-m2v-pipeline#91; sweeps run before that PR merges and releases exercise the pipeline's code defaults instead, so this fighter's sweep must be sequenced after #91 merges. There is no plugin floor/pin field in this registry schema, so the floor must already be installed in the runner environment.
